seo.title: The desk worker’s back guide | Harbour Physio
seo.description: A free 10-minute routine for lower back stiffness from sitting all day, with photos for every movement.

hero.headline: Ease a stiff back in ten minutes a day
hero.subhead: Six movements for people who sit at a desk, with a photo and a common mistake for each one.

items.title: A 10-minute routine
items.body: Six movements you can do beside your desk. No mat or equipment.

items.title: Photos for every step
items.body: See the start and end position, plus the mistake most people make.

items.title: When to see someone
items.body: The signs that mean stretching is not enough and you should book an assessment.

quotes.quote: A real patient quote goes here.

items.q: Is this a replacement for treatment?
items.a: No. It is a starting point. If pain gets worse or spreads, stop and book an assessment.

items.q: How soon will I notice a difference?
items.a: It varies from person to person. The guide explains what to track so you can tell.
